fields.name: Name

filter.placeholder: Filter by field, value or path

fields.label: What this field is called
fields.labelHint: Leave it empty to use the name the document gives it.
fields.noteHint: Sent with this field on the next reading.
fields.notePlaceholder: e.g. this is a row of the table, not the total

sections.annotateLabel: What to watch for in this block
sections.annotateHint: Sent with this block's fields on the next reading.
sections.annotatePlaceholder: e.g. this table has one row per obligation; extract each row with its name.

new.title: Define document type
new.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved yet. First the sample document is analyzed, then you choose what will be asked of every document of this type.
new.sampleFileHint: Upload one example of the paper you will keep receiving: the field list comes from it.
new.loadingHint: This can take about a minute
new.error: We could not analyze the document. Please try again.
new.reporterProposed: The analysis proposes “{field}” as the tax id of the reporting party. On the sample it reads “{value}”.
new.reporterNotProposed: The analysis did not find the tax id of the reporting party in this document.

select.title: What will be asked of every document of this type
select.hint: The identification and the amounts start ticked, which is usually what is needed. Everything else — dates, wording, headings — starts unticked: tick what you do need and untick what you do not. Whatever stays unticked is not extracted.
select.empty: The analysis found no fields in this document.

taxYears.title: Tax years
taxYears.label: Tax years (optional)
taxYears.hint: Leave it empty and the type works for any year. Fill it in when an issuer changes its certificate from one year to the next and the same paperwork needs two configurations.
taxYears.invalid: This does not look like a year: {years}. Write four-digit years separated by commas.

blocked.noFields: Tick at least one field: a type with no fields extracts nothing.

new.createError: We could not create the type. Try again — your choices are not lost.

created.title: “{name}” was created
created.hint: It is already used to recognize and extract documents like this one.
created.unmappedTitle: These fields will be extracted but never reconciled

new.sampleDocumentHint: This is the paper the type will be configured from. It is saved with the type, so the fields can be checked against it later.
new.samplePending: The sample document shows up here, so the fields can be read against the paper.
new.previewUnsupported: This kind of file cannot be previewed here.

edit.title: Configure document type
edit.notFound: We could not find this document type.
edit.activeHint: Only active types are used to classify incoming documents.
edit.saveError: Could not save the changes. Please try again.

status.notMapped: This type feeds nothing into reconciliation
status.notMappedHint: It is still extracted as usual: no field has a concept assigned, so there is nothing to cross-check. Nothing is broken.
status.unusable: The reporting party's tax id is missing

reporter.title: Reporting party identification
reporter.hint: The most important control on this screen: it says whose figures the document states.
reporter.path: Field holding the reporting party's tax id
reporter.pathHint: Pick the field carrying the tax identification NUMBER, not the entity's name.
reporter.missingTitle: Without this field the type reconciles nothing
reporter.missing: The server discards EVERY mapping on this type when it cannot attribute the figures to a tax id, and each claim this document should back is reported as missing.
reporter.namePath: Field holding the reporting party's name
reporter.nameHint: Optional. Only used to show whose document it is; it does not replace the tax id.
reporter.blocksSave: Pick the field holding the reporting party's tax id before saving the mappings.
reporter.sourceHint: Pick the field holding the issuer's tax id NUMBER. If the document never prints it, type the tax id here and it is used for every document of this type.
reporter.sourcePlaceholder: A field of the document, or a tax id like 890903938
reporter.nameSourceHint: Only used to show whose document this is; it does not replace the tax id. Pick a field or type the name.
reporter.nameSourcePlaceholder: A field of the document, or a name

period.hint: Pick the field with the year or month the document certifies.
period.missing: Without a period, a certificate for one year can be reconciled against another.
period.sourceHint: Pick the field with the year the document certifies. If it does not say, type the year here.
period.sourcePlaceholder: A field of the document, or a year like 2025

fields.title: What each field of the document says
fields.hint: For every field answer two things: what that value is, and which line of the base report it should back. Untick the fields you do not need: they stop being asked for during extraction. A field with no concept is still extracted, it just takes no part in reconciliation.
fields.removed: Will be removed from the schema on save
fields.removedCount: {count} field will be removed from the schema on save. | {count} fields will be removed from the schema on save.
fields.empty: This type does not declare any field yet.
fields.conceptHint: What the paper calls it: balance, interest, withholding…
fields.spineQuestion: Which line of the base report does it answer?
fields.spineHint: The line this value has to back. Leave several fields on the same line and they are added together.
fields.noSpine: Not compared against the base report
fields.summed: This document contributes {count} values to this line: they are added together and the total is what gets compared against the base report.
fields.mixedComparison: Careful: this line mixes values compared account by account with values compared as a total. They cannot be added together, so they should all use the same comparison.

comparison.question: How does the system compare it?
comparison.totalHint: The paper shows a single figure for the whole entity. That total is what gets compared.
comparison.perAccountHint: The paper lists one row per account, with its number. The comparison is made account by account.

fields.accountPathHint: The field the AI reads each figure’s account from. Without it there is no account to pair against.
fields.accountPathMissing: You said the certificate details each account, but no field holds the account number. Until one does, the total is compared instead, so a figure the certificate does state is not reported as missing.
fields.accountPathMissingCount: {count} field is marked as detailing each account with no account-number field: it will be compared as a total. | {count} fields are marked as detailing each account with no account-number field: they will be compared as totals.
fields.notExtracted: Not extracted — tick it and save to start extracting it

rows.question: Is every field in this block the same thing?
rows.same: Yes, they are all the same
rows.sameHint: One mapping covers every row — one balance per account, say.
rows.eachHint: Each row is mapped on its own — salaries, severance and social benefits in one table, say.
rows.labelFieldHint: The column that tells one row from another. That field stops being mapped on its own.

mappingChanges.title: What happened to the mappings
mappingChanges.entry_dropped: The mapping from {field} to concept {concept} was dropped.
mappingChanges.path_cleared: The {path} field was cleared from the reconciliation configuration.
mappingChanges.mapping_cleared: The whole mapping for this type was cleared: until it is configured again, it reconciles nothing.
mappingChanges.prune_failed: The server could not fit the mapping to this schema; review it before going on.
mappingChanges.unknown: The server adjusted the mapping ({change}) at {path}.

edit.savePartialTitle: The type was saved, its mapping was not
edit.savePartialDescription: The document changes were stored, but the concept mapping could not be saved. Review the concepts and save again — the rest does not need redoing.

sample.title: The document this type was configured from
sample.hint: The fields below were taken from this paper. Check them against it to confirm the right things are being read.

recover.title: Recover names, blocks and the sample's values
recover.hint: Some fields below are missing the paper's own name for them, their block, or the value the sample carried. «{file}» can be read again to fill those in. The prompt, the schema and the mappings are left alone, and anything already named by hand is kept.
recover.failed: The document could not be read. Try again.
recover.done: Filled in {named} fields, out of {total}. The document was saved with the type.
recover.nothing: No field could be filled in: reading «{file}» again, the model found none of the fields this type declares on the paper. It may be a different document, or the page may not state them. Nothing was deleted; the document was saved with the type.

remove.title: Delete this type
remove.hint: This removes the type with its schema, its prompt and its mappings to the exogena. It cannot be undone. If documents are already classified as it, deactivate it above instead: it stops classifying new documents and the existing ones stay readable.
remove.refusedTitle: Cannot delete: documents of this type already exist
remove.refused: Deleting it would leave those documents unable to say what they are or which exogena line they answer. Deactivate it above: it stops classifying new documents and the existing ones stay readable.
remove.failed: The type could not be deleted. Try again.

regenerate.title: Regenerate the configuration from the sample
regenerate.hint: Read «{file}» again so the model proposes the prompt and the schema afresh. Fields that already exist keep their path, so the mappings survive. This is the only way to add a field the type never asked for.
regenerate.guidance: What did the last reading miss?
regenerate.guidancePlaceholder: E.g.: the «Obligaciones a Cargo» table has one row per obligation (loan and credit card). Extract every row with its name, capital, interest and other charges.
regenerate.failed: The type could not be regenerated. Try again.
regenerate.removed: {count} fields that would stop being extracted
regenerate.kept: {count} fields stay as they are, with their mappings.
regenerate.noChange: The new reading declares the same fields. The extraction prompt does change; apply it only if you want that new wording.
regenerate.applyHint: Only ticked fields are saved. A field this reading dropped comes back by ticking it and reading again — the model writes the schema, not this screen.

reread.hint: The next reading gets what you kept, what you called it, and your per-field notes. What you unticked is not proposed again.
reread.placeholder: e.g. the "Obligaciones a Cargo" table has one row per obligation. Extract each row with its name, capital and interest.

reconciliation.generatedAt: Run on {moment}. Each document's status comes from that run: if you changed a type's configuration, reconcile again.

reconciliation.unsupportedHint: Figures the certificate reports and the exogena never mentions. Usually deductions nobody claimed.
